422_ap_missing_mathe_id.description: Raised when application is 'mathe' but no entity_id is found in the operator properties.

value.error: Malformed AP Graph: For 'mathe' application, 'entity_id' must be provided in operator properties.

422_ap_missing_input_edge.description: Raised when application is 'portal' but the operator has no incoming 'input' edge to provide a dataset ID.

value.error: Malformed AP Graph: No input dataset linked to the Recommender Operator.

422_ap_missing_operator.description: Raised when the DatasetRecommender_Operator node is completely missing from the graph.

value.error: Malformed AP Graph: Operator 'DatasetRecommender_Operator' not found.

403.description: The user is authenticated but does not have permission to view this entity.

value.message: Insufficient permissions for the requested entity_id.
